Remaining Public surfaces still on global 300/min without a tighter decorator: feedback POST (honeypot exists but no @Throttle), comments GET list, STAC, OGC Features/Tiles, health/portal-info (intentionally open). proposals.title: Continue #162 i18n on field related-sheet chrome
proposals.summary: After R10 offline/GPS i18n (#415), field-runtime related bottom sheet still hard-codes English on Back to list, Collapse/Expand sheet, Close, Edit / Copy button labels and titles (Edit this feature / Create a new feature… / You do not have edit access…), and the list header '{n} item(s)'. Extract into fieldRuntime / fieldRelated catalogs with t() calls. No Weblate, no RTL.
proposals.rationale: Highest-visibility remaining field chrome for EU / LatAm collectors after offline/GPS. Related drill-in is the everyday edit path on deployments with parent/child layers.
proposals.risk: Keep hit.editable gating logic unchanged. Machine-translate non-en with Phase 1.1 pattern. Scope to sheet chrome only — offline dialog and related-list body are separate proposals.
proposals.ethosFit: Language follow-through on free field chrome. No Contour brand kit.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Wire related-sheet Back/Collapse/Expand/Close/Edit/Copy/N-items strings through en/es/fr/de/pt-BR; What's new optional (i18n-only can skip).

proposals.title: Continue #162 i18n on offline download dialog titles
proposals.summary: Offline download DialogTitle still hard-codes 'Download failed' / 'Ready for offline' / 'Downloading for offline' while the body already uses formatOfflineMessage(t, …) and layer/feature breakdown keys. Extract the three titles into fieldOffline and call t().
proposals.rationale: Collectors see this dialog every time they leave signal. Body is localized; titles still flash English.
proposals.risk: Do not invent new progress phases. Reuse fieldOffline namespace. Skip What's new if i18n-only.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest localized offline readiness, not Field Maps cosplay.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add fieldOffline.downloadFailedTitle / readyTitle / downloadingTitle; wire DialogTitle; catalogs + locales.spec.

proposals.title: Continue #162 i18n on related-record list chrome
proposals.summary: Parent-feature related section still hard-codes Add button titles ('Add a new {layer} record…' / 'This child layer is not editable in this deployment'), load-error copy ('Couldn't load existing …'), empty state ('No … records yet'), plus submit/save fallbacks ('Could not save' / 'Submit failed.'). Extract with ICU placeholders for layer labels.
proposals.rationale: Pairs with related-sheet chrome. Parent/child demos are a core data-collection pitch; English-only related lists undermine #162.
proposals.risk: Preserve childEditable gating. Keep API error bodies as server-provided when present; only localize the fallbacks and static chrome.
proposals.ethosFit: Free related-record capture without Survey123 seats.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Extract related-list Add/empty/error/submit fallbacks into catalogs; wire t(); locales.spec.

proposals.title: Document Public tool run 30/min throttle in tool help
proposals.summary: #422 throttles POST /api/tools/:id/run at 30/min but help/items/tool.md and reference/api.md do not mention the cap. Authors embedding public OSM tools in Custom Web Apps need to know anonymous viewers share a per-IP budget with drawings writes.
proposals.rationale: docs-every-commit left a small honesty hole: security CHANGELOG shipped, user/author help did not. Same class as recipe truncated honesty.
proposals.risk: Do not invent per-user authenticated exemptions that the ThrottlerGuard does not implement. One short paragraph + CHANGELOG docs note; skip What's new.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest public-tool limits. Prefer docs over silent 429 surprises.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add rate-limit note to tool.md (+ api.md if tools run is listed); CHANGELOG docs; QUEUE.

proposals.title: i18n ComingSoon item stub chrome (#162)
proposals.summary: coming-soon.tsx hard-codes '{label}: coming soon' for item types that land on the stub. Extract into a small itemChrome / comingSoon catalog so non-en locales do not flash English on unfinished item surfaces.
proposals.rationale: Tiny finishable #162 slice. Demo authors occasionally open stub types; English-only stub undermines locale switcher credibility.
proposals.risk: Do not invent new item types. Keep stub behaviour; localize the label template only.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest unfinished surfaces in the user's language.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add comingSoon.template key; wire t(); five catalogs; skip What's new.

proposals.title: Tighter throttle on Public POST /api/feedback
proposals.summary: FeedbackController.submit is @Public with honeypot + per-address limits but no @Throttle decorator, so it rides the global 300/min ThrottlerGuard. Anonymous screenshot uploads can still burn bandwidth. Add @Throttle({ default: { ttl: 60_000, limit: 30 } }) matching drawings writes / tools run.
proposals.rationale: Standing Low follow-up after SEC-tools-run-throttle. Small hardening, no product call.
proposals.risk: Legitimate reporters behind shared NATs share one bucket — 30/min is still ample for humans. Keep honeypot behaviour unchanged.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add @Throttle 30/min on feedback submit; CHANGELOG Security note; skip What's new.

proposals.title: Tighter throttle on Public GET /api/items/:id/comments
proposals.summary: CommentsController.list is @Public for public items with only the global 300/min guard. Add @Throttle({ default: { ttl: 60_000, limit: 60 } }) matching Records list. Auth POSTs for create/reply stay ungated by this decorator (or inherit global).
proposals.rationale: Public DoS checklist item for unauthenticated list endpoints. Low severity; finishes the comments surface after feature-anchored comments shipped.
proposals.risk: Polling UIs must stay under 60/min. Confirm client poll intervals before merging if any exist.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add @Throttle 60/min on comments list; CHANGELOG Security; skip What's new.

proposals.title: Continue #162 i18n on field Loading/Searching/Persistent chrome
proposals.summary: field-runtime still hard-codes Loading…, Searching…, and a green Persistent storage badge span (storagePersistent key may already exist unused). Wire remaining status chrome through catalogs after the larger related/offline slices.
proposals.rationale: Small mop-up after related-sheet / offline dialog / related-list. Keeps #162 finishable without Weblate.
proposals.risk: Confirm storagePersistent key before adding duplicates. Skip What's new.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Wire Loading/Searching/Persistent (and leftover Failed to load fallbacks) via t(); catalogs.
